title: Job, Chapter 36 (Leningrad Codex)
source: Leningrad Codex folios (Internet Archive, WSRP photographs) + tanach.us LC folio index + UXLC Hebrew + KJV
description: Job 36 on folios 407r, 407v of the Leningrad Codex (1008 AD), the oldest complete Hebrew Bible. Hebrew from the UXLC transcription of this manuscript; English KJV.
introduction:
Job chapter 36 from the Leningrad Codex (Codex Leningradensis, National Library of Russia, Firkovich EBP. I B 19a), copied in Cairo by Samuel ben Jacob and dated 1008/1009 AD, the oldest complete manuscript of the Hebrew Bible and the base text of the Biblia Hebraica editions. This chapter stands on folios 407r, 407v.

This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library:

  1. Manuscript scan: the specific folio side(s) carrying each section's verses, from the full-colour West Semitic Research Project photographs of the codex as redistributed on Internet Archive (item Leningrad_Codex_Color_Images, marked Creative Commons Public Domain Mark 1.0). Folio-to-verse ranges come from the tanach.us LC folio index, which was derived from the West Semitic Research Project's published index; each section links only to the page(s) whose recorded verse range contains its verses.
  2. Original text: the verbatim Hebrew of this manuscript in the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex (UXLC 2.5 build 27.6, tanach.us), a transcription of Firkovich B 19a with vowels and cantillation, released without restriction on the biblical text.
  3. English translation: the King James Version (1611, public domain), retrieved verbatim from bolls.life (KJV text, Strong's numbers stripped).
translator_notes: פ and ס mark the open and closed paragraph breaks visible as gaps in the manuscript columns.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>וַיֹּ֥סֶף אֱלִיה֗וּא וַיֹּאמַֽר׃ <sup>2</sup>כַּתַּר־לִ֣י זְ֭עֵיר וַאֲחַוֶּ֑ךָּ כִּ֤י ע֖וֹד לֶאֱל֣וֹהַּ מִלִּֽים׃ <sup>3</sup>אֶשָּׂ֣א דֵ֭עִי לְמֵרָח֑וֹק וּ֝לְפֹעֲלִ֗י אֶֽתֵּֽן־צֶֽדֶק׃ <sup>4</sup>כִּֽי־אָ֭מְנָם לֹא־שֶׁ֣קֶר מִלָּ֑י תְּמִ֖ים דֵּע֣וֹת עִמָּֽךְ׃ <sup>5</sup>הֶן־אֵ֣ל כַּ֭בִּיר וְלֹ֣א יִמְאָ֑ס כַּ֝בִּ֗יר כֹּ֣חַֽ לֵֽב׃ <sup>6</sup>לֹא־יְחַיֶּ֥ה רָשָׁ֑ע וּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט עֲנִיִּ֣ים יִתֵּֽן׃ <sup>7</sup>לֹֽא־יִגְרַ֥ע מִצַּדִּ֗יק עֵ֫ינָ֥יו וְאֶת־מְלָכִ֥ים לַכִּסֵּ֑א וַיֹּשִׁיבֵ֥ם לָ֝נֶ֗צַח וַיִּגְבָּֽהוּ׃ <sup>8</sup>וְאִם־אֲסוּרִ֥ים בַּזִּקִּ֑ים יִ֝לָּכְד֗וּן בְּחַבְלֵי־עֹֽנִי׃
translation.text: <sup>1</sup>Elihu also proceeded, and said, <sup>2</sup>Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf. <sup>3</sup>I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker. <sup>4</sup>For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee. <sup>5</sup>Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom. <sup>6</sup>He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor. <sup>7</sup>He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted. <sup>8</sup>And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

translation.original_text: <sup>9</sup>וַיַּגֵּ֣ד לָהֶ֣ם פָּעֳלָ֑ם וּ֝פִשְׁעֵיהֶ֗ם כִּ֣י יִתְגַּבָּֽרוּ׃ <sup>10</sup>וַיִּ֣גֶל אָ֭זְנָם לַמּוּסָ֑ר וַ֝יֹּ֗אמֶר כִּֽי־יְשֻׁב֥וּן מֵאָֽוֶן׃ <sup>11</sup>אִֽם־יִשְׁמְע֗וּ וְֽיַעֲ֫בֹ֥דוּ יְכַלּ֣וּ יְמֵיהֶ֣ם בַּטּ֑וֹב וּ֝שְׁנֵיהֶ֗ם בַּנְּעִימִֽים׃ <sup>12</sup>וְאִם־לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁמְעוּ בְּשֶׁ֣לַח יַעֲבֹ֑רוּ וְ֝יִגְוְע֗וּ כִּבְלִי־דָֽעַת׃ <sup>13</sup>וְֽחַנְפֵי־לֵ֭ב יָשִׂ֣ימוּ אָ֑ף לֹ֥א יְ֝שַׁוְּע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲסָרָֽם׃ <sup>14</sup>תָּמֹ֣ת בַּנֹּ֣עַר נַפְשָׁ֑ם וְ֝חַיָּתָ֗ם בַּקְּדֵשִֽׁים׃ <sup>15</sup>יְחַלֵּ֣ץ עָנִ֣י בְעָנְי֑וֹ וְיִ֖גֶל בַּלַּ֣חַץ אָזְנָֽם׃ <sup>16</sup>וְאַ֤ף הֲסִיתְךָ֨ ׀ מִפִּי־צָ֗ר רַ֭חַב לֹא־מוּצָ֣ק תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ וְנַ֥חַת שֻׁ֝לְחָנְךָ֗ מָ֣לֵא דָֽשֶׁן׃
translation.text: <sup>9</sup>Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded. <sup>10</sup>He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity. <sup>11</sup>If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures. <sup>12</sup>But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge. <sup>13</sup>But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them. <sup>14</sup>They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean. <sup>15</sup>He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression. <sup>16</sup>Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

translation.original_text: <sup>17</sup>וְדִין־רָשָׁ֥ע מָלֵ֑אתָ דִּ֖ין וּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט יִתְמֹֽכוּ׃ <sup>18</sup>כִּֽי־חֵ֭מָה פֶּן־יְסִֽיתְךָ֣ בְסָ֑פֶק וְרָב־כֹּ֝֗פֶר אַל־יַטֶּֽךָּ׃ <sup>19</sup>הֲיַעֲרֹ֣ךְ שׁ֭וּעֲךָ לֹ֣א בְצָ֑ר וְ֝כֹ֗ל מַאֲמַצֵּי־כֹֽחַ׃ <sup>20</sup>אַל־תִּשְׁאַ֥ף הַלָּ֑יְלָה לַעֲל֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽם׃ <sup>21</sup>הִ֭שָּׁמֶר אַל־תֵּ֣פֶן אֶל־אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־עַל־זֶ֝֗ה בָּחַ֥רְתָּ מֵעֹֽנִי׃ <sup>22</sup>הֶן־אֵ֭ל יַשְׂגִּ֣יב בְּכֹח֑וֹ מִ֖י כָמֹ֣הוּ מוֹרֶֽה׃ <sup>23</sup>מִֽי־פָקַ֣ד עָלָ֣יו דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּמִֽי־אָ֝מַ֗ר פָּעַ֥לְתָּ עַוְלָֽה׃ <sup>24</sup>זְ֭כֹר כִּֽי־תַשְׂגִּ֣יא פָעֳל֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר שֹׁרְר֣וּ אֲנָשִֽׁים׃
translation.text: <sup>17</sup>But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee. <sup>18</sup>Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee. <sup>19</sup>Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength. <sup>20</sup>Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place. <sup>21</sup>Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction. <sup>22</sup>Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him? <sup>23</sup>Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity? <sup>24</sup>Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

translation.original_text: <sup>25</sup>כָּל־אָדָ֥ם חָֽזוּ־ב֑וֹ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ יַבִּ֥יט מֵרָחֽוֹק׃ <sup>26</sup>הֶן־אֵ֣ל שַׂ֭גִּיא וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע מִסְפַּ֖ר שָׁנָ֣יו וְלֹא־חֵֽקֶר׃ <sup>27</sup>כִּ֭י יְגָרַ֣ע נִטְפֵי־מָ֑יִם יָזֹ֖קּוּ מָטָ֣ר לְאֵדֽוֹ׃ <sup>28</sup>אֲשֶֽׁר־יִזְּל֥וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים יִ֝רְעֲפ֗וּ עֲלֵ֤י ׀ אָדָ֬ם רָֽב׃ <sup>29</sup>אַ֣ף אִם־יָ֭בִין מִפְרְשֵׂי־עָ֑ב תְּ֝שֻׁא֗וֹת סֻכָּֽתֽוֹ׃ <sup>30</sup>הֵן־פָּרַ֣שׂ עָלָ֣יו אוֹר֑וֹ וְשָׁרְשֵׁ֖י הַיָּ֣ם כִּסָּֽה׃ <sup>31</sup>כִּי־בָ֭ם יָדִ֣ין עַמִּ֑ים יִֽתֶּן־אֹ֥כֶל לְמַכְבִּֽיר׃ <sup>32</sup>עַל־כַּפַּ֥יִם כִּסָּה־א֑וֹר וַיְצַ֖ו עָלֶ֣יהָ בְמַפְגִּֽיעַ׃ <sup>33</sup>יַגִּ֣יד עָלָ֣יו רֵע֑וֹ מִ֝קְנֶ֗ה אַ֣ף עַל־עוֹלֶֽה׃
translation.text: <sup>25</sup>Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off. <sup>26</sup>Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out. <sup>27</sup>For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof: <sup>28</sup>Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly. <sup>29</sup>Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle? <sup>30</sup>Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea. <sup>31</sup>For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance. <sup>32</sup>With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt. <sup>33</sup>The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.
